general_information.Description: The course explores and focuses around the managerial functions of management: Planning, Organizing, Leading and Controlling. The course is designed to provide basic skills required in management, how the principles of management developed, the necessary attributes of manager, and coverage of significant management theories. The course will also serve as an introduction to mini case studies, which involves each group working as a management team. Learning in the class will be facilitated through the use of vehicles such as textbook readings, class discussion, exercises/activities, cases, self quizzes and lectures..
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Analyze and apply the various theories relating to the field of management
Analyze various leadership and supervision styles and effects on employee morale and productivity
Demonstrate methods of effectively influencing delegating and motivating
Identify and demonstrate the process of planning information gathering, decision-making, and communicating skills

assessments.Question Type: Each student shoud make at least 1 individual presentation during the course in front of the class. Topics will be varied based on the topics in the textbook.
assessments.Note: While this is a subjective measure, I will try to standardize it as much as possible by tracking your participation in class discussions and activities. Several of the in-class activities will involve small group discussions. Reading in advance is the MUST. Also, arriving late to class causes a distraction and will hurt your participation grade.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The question will cover the lectures, class discussions, activities, exercises, and textbook.

assessments.No Question: Maximum length of the group assignment should be 10 pages excluding appendices
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on topics of studied units
assessments.Note: All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and must be submitted in the hard copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission Recommended: 30% for presentation and 70% for the written report.

assessments.Question Type: A student is required to interview one manager (in charge of at least 3 staff) to analyze 17 roles of a manager (according to Minzberg's classification): identify the actual roles that a manager is acting, and his or her difficulties in acting those roles
assessments.Note: Students are required to provide a specific contact of that interviewed manager: name, company name, address, website (if have), phone number

assessments.Question Type: Multiple choice questions (15 questions) , exercises or essay question (1 question each)
assessments.No Question: Multiple choice questions (15 questions) , exercises or essay question (1 question each)
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Quizzes and exercises will test for knowledge of subjects in the chapters assigned for that day.
assessments.Note: These quizzes and exercises will be given at various times during class (beginning, middle or end-another good reason to arrive on time). Total number of quizzes: 4.
